terminal-env.note: Env file in a terminal: database password in a URL, AWS pair, Stripe key. Names, a phone number, paths and a test count must stay.

chat-wifi.note: Chat with an unlabelled wifi password and a door code in prose. People, phone, email, invoice and price must stay.

email-temp-password.note: Email with a temporary password and a one-time code, neither labelled with the word password. Sender, recipient, PO, rate and phone must stay.

code-literal-key.note: Python that handles secrets (must stay readable) with two literal credentials near the bottom.

key-block-no-header.note: The tail of a private key in a terminal with the BEGIN line scrolled off. The file listing must stay.

bank.note: Bank page: account, routing and card numbers must go; names, payees and amounts stay.

notes-codes.note: Personal notes: alarm and padlock codes, a recovery phrase and a router password among ordinary reminders.

hr-sheet.note: A staff table: every SSN must go, names, phones and dates stay.

dense-log.note: Forty dense log lines at small size with a bearer token and a GitHub token buried in them.

clean-code.note: Code about secrets with none in it. Nothing should be hidden.

contacts.note: A directory of names, emails and phone numbers. Nothing should be hidden.

web-wikipedia.note: A real public page. Nothing should be hidden.
